mcp_no_script_hint: MCP tools don't need script content. Configure MCP Server and tool name in Basic Info.
index_exts_hint: Empty = the engine's default extension set; the index is rebuilt in the background after saving.
exclude_paths_hint: Excluded by gitignore syntax (comma or newline separated, one rule per item): a trailing `/` matches directories only; `#` comment, `!` negation, `*`/`?`/`**`/`[..]` wildcards; rules containing `/` are anchored to the project root. `.git`/`.chonkpilot` are always excluded (cannot be negated), while `.trae`/`node_modules`/`dist` etc. are defaults that `!` can re-include. When "Stack .gitignore" is checked, per-directory `.gitignore`, `.git/info/exclude` and the global ignore file are additionally applied (this input has the highest priority); the index is rebuilt in the background after saving.

keep_full_max_turns_hint: 0 = turn limit disabled; 0 for both this and the token bound = no compression (keep everything). The latest turn always stays fully intact.
keep_full_max_turns_invalid: Invalid value (< 0): this setting is ignored (treated as disabled); enter an integer >= 0
keep_full_max_tokens_hint: 0 = token bound disabled; 0 for both this and the turn limit = no compression (keep everything).
keep_full_max_tokens_invalid: Invalid value (< 0): this setting is ignored (treated as disabled); enter an integer >= 0
keep_full_max_illegal_warning: Turn/token bound is negative (invalid); saved as "disabled". Please use an integer >= 0
summary_prompt_placeholder: Enter the summary prompt used for compression...
summary_prompt_source_inherit: Source: inherited (system-level / built-in default, no project override)
summary_prompt_source_override: Source: project override (shadows system-level / built-in default)
summary_prompt_reset_done: Override removed; reverted to the inherited value
summary_prompt_inherit_kept: No override written (content equals the inherited value)
context_desc: Full retention = the latest turn always stays fully intact; earlier turns are taken in from newest to oldest while within the latest N turns AND the cumulative M-token bound — anything beyond either limit enters the simplified area → when the simplified area exceeds the threshold, it is auto-compressed into an LLM summary.
context_calc: Simplified-area token = sum of (message chars / 2) over the turns in the simplified area (pre-stored per-turn token counts are accumulated directly when available).
context_example: Example: N=10 turns, M=24000 tokens, threshold=20000 → the latest turn always stays full; earlier turns within 10 turns and 24000 tokens stay full, anything beyond is simplified; compression triggers when the simplified area exceeds the threshold. N=0 means unlimited turns, M=0 means unlimited tokens, both 0 means no compression.
context_async: Compression runs asynchronously after each turn, mutually exclusive within the same session, no duplicate triggers.
context_tip_cache_billing: If your provider bills purely by token and does not bill for cache hits, it is recommended to reduce the keep turns to 1
context_tip_compress_llm: Context compression and memory extraction use the default LLM; a specific LLM is coming soon
memory_enabled_hint: When enabled, each turn is asynchronously distilled into category files; disabled means no distillation.
memory_min_turn_tokens: Min tokens to distill (skip turns below this)
memory_category_max_tokens_hint: Reminder only: categories exceeding this estimated token count are highlighted as a hint to split memory; memory content is never truncated or trimmed (distillation is not blocked).
memory_user_pref_hint: User-level memory (~/.chonkpilot/用户偏好.md), shared across projects; when enabled it is distilled asynchronously at the end of each turn.
memory_subsession_hint: Sub-sessions (each LLM call from DSL batch orchestration/delegation) skip memory distillation by default; enable to also distill sub-session turns. Not recommended to enable for batch processing.
memory_content_placeholder: Enter memory content for this category (Markdown)...
memory_delete_confirm: Delete category "{name}" and its content file? This cannot be undone.
memory_total_hint: The clickable entry is in the window status bar (Memory · total): open it, pick a category, then view/edit its content.
memory_optimize_use_case: Memory category body: project/user facts and conventions distilled into this category, read on demand by later conversations
memory_prompt_placeholder: Enter this category's memory distillation prompt (the LLM merges new turn info into this category's full text)...
memory_prompt_source_default: Currently the built-in default prompt (saving will override it)
memory_prompt_source_custom: Currently a custom prompt (use "Reset" to clear it and fall back to the built-in default)
memory_prompt_reset_done: Reset to the built-in default prompt
memory_prompt_optimize_use_case: Memory distillation: merge and rewrite new turn info into the full text of a memory category
compress_subsession_hint: Sub-sessions (each LLM call from DSL batch orchestration/delegation) skip context compression by default; enable to also compress sub-session turns. Not recommended to enable for batch processing.
log_level_hint: Writes the project config logLevel; takes effect immediately after saving, no restart needed.
log_saved: Log level saved and applied immediately (no restart needed)
log_dir_open_failed: Failed to open the log directory
log_dir_unavailable: File logging is not enabled: no log directory (logDir is omitted when no file sink is attached).
log_dir_browser_hint: The browser form cannot open folders directly (native capabilities are disabled); copy the path and open it yourself.
engine_tool_state_hint: Registered = the engine query tools are injected into the tool surface (engine enabled with an active instance); plugins expose no "subprocess running" signal, so only the registration state is shown.
docs_hint: When enabled, document files (.docx/.xlsx/.pptx/.pdf) are first extracted to text by the Document Conversion Service, then indexed (off by default). The plugin only probes it and never starts it — register and launch it yourself on the MCP config page.
docs_max_mb_hint: Per-file limit for documents (independent of the 8MB source limit); larger files are skipped. Empty = default 50MB.
docs_register_title: How to register as an MCP server
docs_register_hint: The service ships with the product but is neither preconfigured nor auto-started; if port 7317 is taken, the actual port is shown in state.json (the status line above shows the detected port).
docs_register_text:
[Add MCP server]
Name:      markitdown (or "Document Converter")
Type:      Streamable HTTP (HTTP)
URL:       http://127.0.0.1:7317/mcp
Launch:    external process (not managed by this product)
Command:   <install dir>\mcps\markitdown\markitdown-mcp.exe
Note:      Converts PDF / Word / Excel / PPT into Markdown (with page / sheet / slide locators) for full-text search and reading.
dict_hint: The tokenizer is fixed to jieba. There is exactly one system-level dictionary shared by all projects (no project/user overrides); the base dictionaries are embedded and read-only, while custom words are editable. Dictionary/custom-word changes require a reindex to take effect.
dict_user_placeholder: One word per line; lines starting with # are comments (e.g. ChonkPilot)
dict_saved: Custom words saved; reindex scheduled in background
filetree_hide_dirs_hint: Matched by directory name at any depth (comma / semicolon / newline separated): matched directories are neither shown in the file tree nor watched (display and watching share one rule). Directories starting with "." are always hidden (not configurable). Empty = fall back to the default list (.git, .svn, .chonkpilot). Takes effect immediately after saving.
